references.text: The instruction to set up the lamps so that they shine in front of the lampstand, which Aaron follows here.
Aaron and his sons were to tend the lamps in the tent of meeting, an arrangement followed here.
Moses set up the lamps before the face of the Lord, just as the Lord had commanded him—the same formula of obedience used regarding Aaron.
Detailed instructions about the lamps on the pure lampstand that are to be tended by Aaron.
The preceding instruction from the Lord to Moses about how the lamps were to be lit, which Aaron obeys here.
The letter to the Hebrews points out that the priests served according to the pattern Moses received on the mountain, which includes the lampstand and its service.
